name: presentations
description: PPTX presentation production skills, published as an official ZCode plugin. Includes a read-only workspace viewer for shared reading, search, references and captures.

description_i18n.en: Presentation production skills for PPTX, with a visual acceptance reviewer agent. Read together in a read-only workspace panel with anchor references, search, highlights and captures.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 PPTX 的演示文稿制作技能，并提供视觉验收评审 Agent。 支持工作区只读共同阅读、锚点引用、搜索、高亮与截图。
